gemini-3-flash.notes: Good CRA awareness mentioning CISA KEV and wild exploitation. Excellent accuracy and completeness including exploit references. Too verbose at ~500+ words but actionable priorities.

analysis: DeepSeek-v3 wins with superior CRA alignment (citing specific articles), excellent conciseness under 300 words, and highly actionable recommendations with specific version requirements.
